metadata.title: Stratified Superintegrability of Spin Calogero-Moser-Sutherland Systems
metadata.abstract: We study the Poisson chain of the compact spin Calogero-Moser-Sutherland system obtained by conjugation reduction of $T^*\mathrm{SU}(n)$ at a fixed coadjoint orbit. We give a Horn-type condition ensuring that the spectral torus acts freely on the full fiber over a simple spectrum; for each orbit, the admissible spectra form a nonempty open dense set, and the restricted chain is strongly superintegrable of rank $n-1$ on every orbit-type stratum. We also construct, across certain affine spectral walls, a proper quotient map onto a Hausdorff stratified Poisson space with a finite Whitney stratification. For $\mathrm{SU}(3)$, we compute the free spectral domain and the quotient near two intersecting walls, and a zero-orbit example shows that the analogous quotient need not be Hausdorff on the unrestricted reduced phase space.
metadata.comment: Guorui Ma is the corresponding auother for this work

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 自旋CMS系统的分层超可积性
analysis.workSummary: 在固定余伴随轨道上由T*SU(n)共轭约化所得紧自旋CMS系统，作者用Horn型条件保证简单谱纤维上的谱环面自由作用；每个轨道可行谱构成非空开稠密集，其限制Poisson链在各轨道型分层上强超可积、秩n−1。
analysis.breakthrough: 在若干仿射谱墙间构造到Hausdorff分层Poisson空间的proper商映射，并算SU(3)双墙交叉例子。
analysis.limitations: Hausdorff性只对受控谱域，零轨道反例说明全约化相空间的类似商可非Hausdorff；不能删去简单谱和自由作用条件。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第25页致谢明确感谢OpenAI ChatGPT-6对Condition (H)的有益建议，构成作者实际协作披露。Condition (H)是全文的互补Horn问题谱条件，但声明未说明模型提出哪一关键构造、证明或文字，故保守记探索讨论，不推断核心ideas、proofs或writing。
